answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 105 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 105 epochs of grading, and every walnut settlement recomputes the ferrous schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
